## Football effect

Poyer played 36 defensive snaps at the nickel and 13 on the kicking game with no tackle, pass defended or target recorded against him before the injury was logged at the end of Indianapolis's possession at 5:19 of the third quarter; he was removed and A.J. Bouye took his place by the chart's order, the kernel's replacement under the frozen chart with no pause recorded (Bouye 26 defensive snaps, two tackles). The hold is the independent medical process's and no football finding attaches to it. On the projection he misses the San Diego and Pittsburgh weeks; his availability follows the independent process's communication, not the projection. The Week 4 nickel is Stone's decision after the Monday exams; the projection by itself requires no roster decision, and any disposition is Caldwell's with the user.
